projects.title: Praxisprojekt
projects.description: Settle, a web app that helps people understand official german government documents. Users select a confusing passage and get a plain-language explanation from a self-hosted Qwen model (Ollama, Node.js/Express, Docker) plus optional DeepL translation.

projects.title: Bachelorthesis
projects.description: A serverless AWS application that tracks flights across Europe in real time and pushes it to clients via WebSockets. The same backend has also been built on a local Node.js server to compare both approaches on architecture, maintainability, scalability, cost and complexity.
